title: Camp Kitaki

services.name: Cabin Fever
services.desc: Think your kids have what it takes to solve a mystery? Then this Clue-themed campout is for them! They’ll sharpen their detective skills with mysterious games, red string theory board and contests to catch the caper. They will also make a few crafts, play some Spyball, and make new friends! If weather permits, we’ll be exploring Kitaki through outdoor activities, so please pack warm winter gear! Give your kids a night of memories, friends, and fun while you go enjoy a quiet evening for Valentine’s Day...you deserve it and so do they! services.name: Summer Camp
services.desc: In today's fast-paced world of rising travel costs, affordable, quality family vacations are harder to find. Your family can enjoy our Family Camp, less than 30 minutes from Lincoln or Omaha. The fees include lodging, meals, activities, and all the fun you can handle! Get away from the hustle and bustle and spend some quality time with the family. Camp Kitaki staff open up the areas and you go at your own pace with your family. Want to spend the whole day by the pool? We won't stop you. Or climb the tower, hike the woods and more! All meals are included so you don't have to worry about cooking or cleaning up.
